question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'

WITH all_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(e.value.int_value AS STRING) END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as ga_session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'source' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as source,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'medium' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as medium,
    event_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e WHERE e.key = 'ga_session_id') > 0
    AND ((SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'source' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) IS NOT NULL 
         OR (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'medium' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) IS NOT NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    source,
    medium,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga_session_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM all_params
),
session_source AS (
  SELECT ga_session_id, source, medium
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'in.search.yahoo.com', 'm.baidu.com', 'yandex.ru')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'in.search.yahoo.com', 'm.baidu.com', 'yandex.ru')
           OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN (source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'shop|shopping'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'shop|shopping'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'mobile')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_source
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) as total_sessions
FROM channel_classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
